description: Heat transfer is the movement of thermal energy in the form of heat from one location to another. The transfer can take place between two bodies, such as between a hot object and a cold one, or between a hot object and its environment. Heat transfer can happening through several mechanisms, such as radiation, conduction, convection, or a combination of these.
